notes.title: Eternal Edge + Out of Early Access and FREE Prologue Released
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32748159/f7ffb20f2441afb5d5da56df5cf68dd7ae69aa29.png[/img]

Hi everyone! If you haven't heard the Eternal Edge + game is now out of early access!! We also released a free prologue of the game that allows you to enjoy the beginning of the Eternal Edge + experience before buying the full game! Features 2-3 hours of gameplay including the Intro, first Major Dungeon, 3 Sub-Dungeons, and free exploration time of 'the Expanse'.

https://youtu.be/GWss0TqwRnI

Save data will be carried over to the full game, so you don't have to worry about losing your hard-earned progress. We hope you enjoy the game!

[h2]Eternal Edge + - Free Prologue[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959480/Eternal_Edge_Prologue/

[h2]Eternal Edge + [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/896440/Eternal_Edge/

notes.title: Isle of Jura - A relaxing fishing adventure game is releasing Feb. 11th!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32748159/9258df30ccccc72201162c0bbc198fe851a74d1e.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Villagers![/h1]

We are excited to share that the Isle of Jura game will be released this Friday, Feb. 11th! We can't wait to see what you all catch in Isle of Jura. We've just uploaded a new build with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1703140/view/3130567756993437861]bug fixes and QOL updates.[/url]

See you on launch day!

[h2]About the Game[/h2]

Alex needs to finish her biology report! Looking for species to study, she's taking a fishing trip to Jura, a remote and beautiful island.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Catch over 50 species of fish
[*] Master 3 different fishing techniques
[*] Find artifacts and complete the island collection
[*] Chat with the island residents
[*] Explore at your own pace
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1703140/Isle_of_Jura/
